answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake in ferrous-denominated collateral before it can earn, and rewards vest over a long voyage of epochs rather than on the first payout. Registering a thousand Sybil clones therefore costs a thousand locked stakes, all forfeit the moment one is caught colluding. A cohort of honest peers, each anchored like a cedar with a track record, cross-attests identities cheaply, so flooding the ledger with fresh accounts yields zero income and a large capital outlay.
